description: Provision an AWS Apigateway VPCLink via the ACK apigateway controller. Fields mirror the apigateway.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 VPCLink spec.

description.description: The description of the VPC link.

name.description: The name used to label and identify the VPC link.

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

tags.description:
The key-value map of strings. The valid character set is [a-zA-Z+-=._:/].
The tag key can be up to 128 characters and must not start with aws:. The
tag value can be up to 256 characters.

targetARNs.description:
The ARN of the network load balancer of the VPC targeted by the VPC link.
The network load balancer must be owned by the same Amazon Web Services account
of the API owner.

title: AWS Apigateway VPCLink
